notes.membership_scope: 2026-27 current clubs; excluded clubs appear only as match opponents or raw responses
notes.player_season_multi_club_totals: Source aggregates across transfers. Flagged rows must not be attributed wholly to one club.
notes.datetime_timezone: Provider datetime strings preserved as supplied; no timezone invented.
notes.future_matches: Fixture rows retained; actual match/player/shot rows require isResult and date <= 2026-10-06.
notes.retrieval_time_recovery: Where an interrupted first acquisition had saved responses before its manifest checkpoint, timestamp recovered from original saved file mtime and explicitly labelled retrieval_timestamp_basis.
notes.xg_aggregation_caution: Displayed team/league xG is not interchangeable with additive shot/player xG. Observed differences preserved in xg_basis_comparison. Possession/rebound adjustment is an inference directly supported by raw arithmetic for the largest-gap sample; no official complete aggregation methodology or possession IDs supplied, so all discrepancies are not individually reconciled.
notes.api_reference: https://understat.com/js/league.min.js and https://understat.com/js/match.min.js expose getLeagueData and getMatchData.
notes.forecast_field_caution: forecast__w/d/l in completed match records are supplied retrospective outputs. Treat as post-match derived unless a verified provider publication timestamp before kickoff is separately obtained.
